instruction: You are an HR Generalist at Northwind Cloud (a 600-person SaaS company). A new software engineer 'Ava Thompson' (role: Backend Engineer, team: Platform, manager: Daniel Okafor, start date: 2026-07-13) has accepted her offer and needs onboarding setup. Step 1: Open Workday and create a new onboarding checklist for employee 'Ava Thompson' on the 'Onboarding' page with the following checklist items (each as a checkbox task): 'Submit I-9 and W-4', 'Order laptop (MacBook Pro 14")', 'Assign Platform team Slack channel', 'Schedule Day-1 orientation', 'Grant GitHub access'. Set the checklist assignee to 'Ava Thompson' and due date to '2026-07-13'. Step 2: Open Google Calendar and create an event titled 'Day-1 Orientation — Ava Thompson' on 2026-07-13 from 09:30 to 11:00, invite Ava Thompson (ava.thompson@northwindcloud.com) and her manager Daniel Okafor (daniel.okafor@northwindcloud.com), with description 'New-hire orientation for Ava Thompson (Backend Engineer, Platform team, manager Daniel Okafor). Onboarding checklist owner: HR.'. Do not create or modify any other Workday records or calendar events.
